title: SAC codes
description: The codes of the Scheme of Classification of Services, the Annexure to Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), for Heading 9983 with its 9 groups and 59 service codes, and for code 997331 with its Heading 9973 and Group 99733, each description as the Annexure prints it. A heading has four digits, a group five and a service code six; a heading's parent is a Section of the Annexure, which carries no code.

instruments: Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), 28 June 2017, G.S.R. 690(E), and its Annexure: Scheme of Classification of Services, in force 1 July 2017
Notification No. 20/2019-Central Tax (Rate), 30 September 2019, G.S.R. 731(E), in force 1 October 2019
